title: Elite: Bind the Rune-Mountain Hall: Warden Duel
description: Elite: Bind the Rune-Mountain Hall: Warden Duel is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet through The Thunder-Oath Gate (Ruin Gate with active oath memory). Your avatar of one selected deity's avatar from Odin, Freyja, Frigg, Thor enters; this beat spotlights Frigg as the reference silhouette while preserving Avatar choice. The mission is the elite step at Rune-Mountain Hall, using storm bridge and world-root trial pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow.
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Rune-Mountain Hall and reveals: Why world-roots remember betrayals. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Earth — Fractured Cathedral Grounds. ancient religious structures cracked by Gate pressure, stained glass dissolved into light-shards, altar stones floating in anti-gravity zones, prayer halls overrun with void-cracks. Neutral ground — no faction advantage or penalty. The Gate has reshaped this terrain.
